description.en:
The DNS Security Ontology (DSecO) project is a data model for representing and reasoning on Domain Name System (DNS) data.
The ontology is developed using web technologies (e.g. RDF, OWL, SKOS) and is intended as a structure for realizing a DNS Knowledge Graph (KG) for administration and security assessment applications. The model has been developed in collaboration with operational teams, and in connection with third parties linked vocabularies.

Alignment with third parties vocabularies is implemented on a per class or per property basis when relevant (e.g. with `rdfs:subClassOf`, `owl:equivalentClass`).
Directions for direct instanciation of these vocabularies are provided for cases where implementing a class/property alignment is redundant.
Alignment holds for the following vocabulary releases:

- [ORG](https://www.w3.org/TR/vocab-org/) 0.8
- [UCO](https://github.com/ucoProject/uco) Release-0.8.0

changeNote.value:
Changes in v2.0.0:

- Used only camelCase for properties : list of properties and their changes:
    - is_CNAME_of -> isCNAMEOf
    - is_A_to -> isATo
    - is_AAAA_to -> isAAAATo
    - resolves_to -> resolvesTo
    - is_in_zone -> isInZONE
    - is_CNAME_of_CNAME_of -> isCNAMEOfCNAMEOf
    - is_part_of -> isPartOf
    - is_hosted_by -> isHostedBy
    - is_included_in -> isIncludedIn
    - isinOurSubnet -> isInOurSubnet
    - FQDN_ends_in_exampleorg -> FQDNEndsInExampleorg
    - answers_on_port_443 -> answersOnPort443
    - answers_on_port_80 -> answersOnPort80
    - answers_on_port -> answersOnPort)
- Deleted TAG and hasTag and replaced it by knownFrom and ORGU_team_GCP

comment.en: A SERVICEID is an identifier of a service, it is associated to a FQDN and can be used to link security indicators.
comment.fr: Un SERVICEID est un identifiant de service associé à un FQDN et pouvant servir à relier des indicateurs de sécurité.

:ZONE_example.com a :ZONE .

comment.en: A domain zone in DNS context. A DNS zone is an administrative subdivision of the DNS namespace.
comment.fr: Une zone de domaine dans le contexte du DNS. Une zone DNS est une subdivision administrative de l’espace de noms DNS.

example.value:
# Example of a FQDN instance
:FQDN_example.com a :FQDN .

comment.en: Fully Qualified Domain Name.
comment.fr: Un fully qualified domain name (FQDN, ou nom de domaine pleinement qualifié) est un nom de domaine qui donne la position exacte de son noeud dans l'arborescence DNS en indiquant tous les domaines de niveau supérieur.
